reviewed_boundaries.offline_persistence: Core stores provider choice/frozen request identity and hosted provenance only. Legacy missing provider fields default Local. Config validation rejects credential-bearing/query/fragment URLs; API keys are not representable in ProviderConfig and Secret has no Serialize. Hosted completion validates provider/model/endpoint; selection changes cancel pending requests transactionally, stale completions cannot publish, and invalid restore preserves notes.
reviewed_boundaries.native_credentials: Only Cueglint service plus provider/canonical-endpoint hash is addressed. Native macOS/Windows keyring backends, redacted errors, zeroizing transient Secret; unsupported platforms return Unavailable with no plaintext substitute. Explicit keyless Compatible use is allowed; credential-read failures on supported stores never become keyless fallback. Evaluator performed no keychain access. The real CLI loopback integration uses production NativeCredentialStore to read a fresh UUID endpoint reference expected Missing; no existing/user key or native save/delete/stored-key roundtrip was exercised by that suite.
reviewed_boundaries.opt_in_and_context: Local is default. Saving selection/key does not send model context. Explicit model-list/test/question actions own network work; test builds a tiny synthetic request without meeting data. The UI names provider/model/endpoint and data destination. Model failures never select another provider or local engine.
reviewed_boundaries.HTTP_DNS_cancel_bounds: No redirects, retries, inherited system proxy, cookies or tools.120s request/20s connect bounds with50ms cancellation polling. Async pending request is retained across polls. One process-wide DNS permit bounds uninterruptible libc resolver work after cancellation; it may remain occupied until resolver returns. Bodies/events/text/catalog/citations are bounded; transport/vendor bodies are excluded from typed public errors. Cancellation disconnects client work but cannot promise server-side processing/billing stops.
reviewed_boundaries.runtime_and_UI: The existing two-slot inference actor owns credentials/network; no provider I/O occurs in draw/audio callbacks. Stable request/operation IDs reject late output. Provider/model switches retire generation and list/test work; CredentialRef+UUID pinned save/delete/status can finish independently. Matching scope+UUID is required before unlocking/clearing a submitted password; changed scope zeroizes it. Password edit history clears and native egui semantic copy/accessibility tests use synthetic values.
reviewed_boundaries.CLI: Separate select/show/key-status/key-save/key-delete/models/test; key-save accepts bounded piped stdin and rejects echoing TTY use. Explicit saved provider chooses ask path; remote rejects local --profile override. Failed/empty output is not committed; success records hosted provenance. No graceful Ctrl-C token bridge is claimed; process exit/reopen recovery remains the boundary.
